title: Laura Merrick (Development):
title_short: Laura Merrick · People Out There Who Care
headline: Laura explains the thing nobody else on the day says: a free pair of shoes lets a family spend that money on another need. And it shows them somebody out there cares.
story: Laura Merrick is on the development team. Her singular passage is practical and warm at the same time: the kids go to school in new shoes, and the family can use the money they would have put towards shoes towards something else that is a need for their family. That is the story. The feeling lands at the end: there's people out there who care about them.
One voice, one person. Her explanation first, then the supporters, then the callback. Calm, clear, kind. No pity.
do: Open on Laura's face, already talking, with the hook text on screen at 0:00.
Keep it one voice. Only Laura speaks.
Cut the shoe table and the fitting under her “distributing shoes” line, then come back to her face for the money line.
End on her face after “who care about them”. Hold 0.5 s.
dont: No logo, no title card, no fade at 0:00.
Do NOT use any other staff interview in this cut.
Do NOT use her “it would just be thank you so much” line (MVI_4305 00:59 to 01:04). It is the hook of the thank-you montage, S4SNashvilleStaffThankYou001.
Do NOT put a money number on screen. She names no number, keep it that way.
Do NOT caption “Souls for Souls”. It is Soles4Souls.
